company_name: First Interstate BancSystem Inc. Common Stock (DE)
title: A Refreshed FirstInterstate.com is Coming in October
summary: First Interstate is refreshing its website with streamlined navigation, easier Online Banking access, enhanced accessibility, and a cleaner design.
body_markdown:
A cleaner design, streamlined navigation, and easier access to Online Banking are coming to our website.


A Simpler Way to Find What You Need


During the week of Oct. 5, First Interstate will introduce a refreshed[firstinterstate.com](https://www.firstinterstate.com/) .


The updated website will have a modern look and feel, with new colors, typography, and design elements. These changes will create a cleaner, more consistent experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.


What You’ll Notice


The refreshed website will include:


- Prominent Online Banking login options on the homepage
- Streamlined navigation with fewer steps between you and the information you need
- A responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
- Enhanced accessibility features to better serve all users
- Simpler product pages with clear, concise information
- Deposit rates organized by state
- A Spanish-language option for deposit rates


You will still use the same website address to access First Interstate information, products, and services.


Creating a More Consistent Digital Experience


The website refresh builds on recent branding updates to Online and Mobile Banking. Together, these improvements create a cleaner and more consistent experience across our digital platforms.


We will continue reviewing and updating website content in the months ahead. These updates will make information easier to understand, find, and use.


Here When You Need Us


At First Interstate, we're committed to meeting you where you are and helping you get where you want to be. Our refreshed website is another step toward making banking simpler and creating a more seamless digital experience.


Beginning the week of Oct. 5, visit[firstinterstate.com](https://www.firstinterstate.com/) to explore the refreshed website.


Questions or need help accessing your account? Visit our[Client Contact Center](https://www.firstinterstatebank.com/support) or call 855-342-3400. Representatives are available Monday – Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. MT (6:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. PT) and Saturday, 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. MT (8:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. PT).
